sources.magnet: STM32 USART1 application uses 115200 8N1 commands and a 50..500 ms timed MAGNET_ON lease. The by-id path ending 5B7A030191 is user-provided deployment data and must be rechecked on Jetson. Production sequence is pick-feedback-confirm -> MAGNET_ON/status-confirm -> release-feedback-confirm -> MAGNET_OFF/status-confirm. physical_pick_verified remains false until post-move visual evidence.
sources.motion: Mounted-camera low-speed setting: duration 6000 ms, global acceleration 10. Arrival requires flushed post-request coordinate replies; telemetry change is not labeled as proven physical motion.

_note: Single active source for NexArm, camera and STM32 magnet endpoints, arm calibration, HOME, motion, arrival, planning gates and workspace parameters. Production Q1 is STM32-only; real energization still requires --confirm RUN_Q1. Stale or uncorrelated feedback is a hard fault and blocks the next pose and magnet ON.
